description: Use when someone wants to find land or lots in Austin or Nashville that fit a need, for example lots where three homes are allowed, commercial land where apartments are allowed without a rezoning, dry industrial land of 5+ acres, zoning where whole-home short-term rentals are permitted, or Specific Plans whose ordinance bans rentals. Pick a ready-made view or describe the need in plain English. Returns how many zoning areas and acres match, the largest ones with a point to pass to land_at, and a map link. Austin views: home3, sb840, co, interim, mfdry, ind5, hist, bsz. Nashville views: strok, spstr, ns, unbuilt, mfusd, ind5, hist, dadu.

city.description: "austin" (City of Austin, Texas) or "nashville" (Nashville and Davidson County, Tennessee). Other cities are not covered.

limit.description: How many of the largest matches to return (default 10)

request.description: Plain-English request instead of a view, for example 'apartments in the city core out of the floodplain'

view.description: A ready-made view id for the city (see the description)

name: find_land

largest.description: The largest matches, each with a point to pass to land_at

title: Find land that fits
